 About the match
 On this page you can find the Esteghlal vs Al-Shamal match lineup for AFC Champions League Elite — Round 4, on Tuesday 03-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Esteghlal lines up in a 5-4-1 led by Cheshmi, while Al-Shamal sets up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Bounedjah. Esteghlal is led by head coach Sohrab Bakhtiarizadeh, while Al-Shamal is managed by David Prats. The match is played at Basra International Stadium.
